pr_title: UX1-436 - Create the modal to delete multiple lists

comments.body:
`footerSlot` is an override for `actionSlot` prop, for when we want to have custom stuff instead of relying on the cmds dialogue component to generate the confirm/cancel buttons. 

Personally prefer using `actionSlot` and leave the spacing and styling to be handled by cmds.

Unnecessary squiggly brackets `{}`. 
Probably copy pasted from the other modal code?
We are gonna go with `appearance: 'link'` for consistency with the other two modals.
Don't think this has worked since they renamed `modal` to `dialog`.

Copy pasta be weird. 
Actually don't need the cast here. `getElementById` returns `HTMLElement | null`, and then we do a null check on the next line..
Doesn't affect performance or anything so 🤷‍♂️

It does get passed all the way down to `@cmds/button` component. 
And then it gets sniped by `react-focus-lock` we are using in the dialog component.
